# Koku Solar

> Engineering-led Solar EPC company based in Thane, Maharashtra, India. MSEDCL Registered Vendor (Installer Category). Specializing in CHSL (housing society), commercial, industrial solar plants, and Virtual Net Metering (VNM) across Maharashtra.

## Company Overview

- **Founded:** 22 April 2024
- **Location:** Thane, Maharashtra, India
- **Website:** https://kokusolar.com
- **Services:** Solar EPC (design, engineering, procurement, construction), AMC & cleaning, monitoring, capex financing support, Virtual Net Metering
- **Segments:** CHSL (cooperative housing societies), commercial, industrial
- **Regulatory:** MSEDCL Registered Vendor — Installer Category
- **Leadership:** IIT-trained engineers with 15+ years of experience in solar EPC design and execution

## Pages

- [Home](https://kokusolar.com/): Overview of services, testimonials, project gallery, and brand story
- [About](https://kokusolar.com/about): Company mission, vision, values, strengths, and team background
- [Services](https://kokusolar.com/services): CHSL Solar EPC, commercial solar EPC, industrial solar EPC, AMC & cleaning, monitoring, capex financing, Virtual Net Metering (VNM)
- [Projects](https://kokusolar.com/projects): Portfolio of 30+ completed, under-execution, and orders-in-hand projects across Maharashtra totalling 5,000+ kWp
- [Blog](https://kokusolar.com/blog): Technical articles on solar regulations, VNM, PM Surya Ghar Yojana subsidy, smart meters, rooftop structural safety, and DCR panel economics
- [Contact](https://kokusolar.com/contact): Request a quote, office location (Thane), phone and email
- [Free Feasibility Report](https://kokusolar.com/free-feasibility-report): Free rooftop solar generation estimate, subsidy calculation, and ROI projection

## Key Topics Covered

- Virtual Net Metering (VNM) for high-rise apartments in Maharashtra
- PM Surya Ghar Yojana government subsidy for housing societies
- Smart meter installation and solar savings
- DCR vs Non-DCR solar panel regulations and cost impact
- Rooftop solar mounting structure safety and terrace slab loading
- MSEDCL net metering process and documentation
- Solar EPC project execution for CHSL, commercial, and industrial segments
